cases.purpose: Compare baseline and task-aware routing for the exact sample workload
expected_behavior: POST returns 202 with a run id and Location header
Each requested task has baseline and optimized attempts in request order
Backend policy version and route reasons are present in the run snapshot
Only complete comparable pairs contribute to aggregate cohort counts
pass_conditions: Terminal state is completed, partial, or failed; polling does not fabricate completion
Every non-null aggregate equals aggregation of eligible backend result pairs using the documented API rules
Missing metrics are null and display as Unavailable in the UI
A negative saved value is preserved and labeled as an increase

answer_correctness.method: Human review against each task's stated expected facts; do not infer equivalence from successful status
answer_correctness.pass_condition: Reviewer records supported facts, material omissions, and contradictions for both outputs; no quality pass is claimed without an agreed rubric

cases.measurement_provenance: simulated demo values; energy and carbon illustrative

cases.purpose: Check single-task selection and unavailable metrics

request.sample_task_selection: one exact task object from GET /api/v1/sample-tasks

expected_behavior: The server accepts a non-empty exact subset of sample tasks
Response retains the selected task for refresh restoration
Zero carbon intensity produces zero carbon totals for eligible energy pairs and a null carbon-savings percentage when its denominator is zero
pass_conditions: Exactly two attempts are returned for the selected task when the deterministic demo fixture completes both policies
No absent usage or metric is converted to numeric zero
A null carbon-savings percentage is rendered Unavailable

answer_correctness.method: Human review against task-specific expected facts
answer_correctness.pass_condition: No equivalence claim; record correctness observations separately from routing/metric checks

cases.measurement_provenance: simulated demo values; carbon intensity is a scenario input

cases.purpose: Ensure Live behavior follows backend capability and never silently falls back
cases.precondition: Use a development configuration that intentionally reports Live unavailable, then separately a provider-enabled configuration approved by the backend owner

request.tasks: valid task objects created in the UI

expected_behavior: When live_enabled is false, UI disables Live submission and shows live_disabled_reason
If an enabled Live request returns 503 LIVE_UNAVAILABLE, UI displays the backend reason and preserves Live mode
No provider secret is sent from or stored in browser code
pass_conditions: No Demo POST is issued after a Live request fails
Provider failures appear on the corresponding attempt with unavailable numeric fields
Observed provenance is shown only when the backend marks the run observed

answer_correctness.method: Use a separately approved task rubric and human evaluation; v1 provides no quality evaluator
answer_correctness.pass_condition: Do not report equal quality without a predeclared evaluation and results

cases.measurement_provenance: depends on backend measurement_source; estimates remain estimates
